paite: Jesse bul a kipan in selnou ahong pawt ding a, azungte a kipan in ahiang hong khangkhe ding hi.
heading: Lalgam Galmuang
english: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.

paite: Huan TOUPA kha pilna leh theihtheihna kha, lemtheihna leh hatna kha theihna leh TOUPA launa kha atung ah atu ding hi.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in akipahna uh TOUPA launa ah ahi ding. Amit a amuh bang in vai ahawm kei ding a, abil a azak bang in leng ataihilh sam kei ding hi.
english: His delight will be in the fear of Yahweh. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;

paite: Diktattak in gentheite vai ahawmsak zaw ding a, lei a mi thunuailutte a ding in khentuam nei lou in ataihilhsak lai ding hi; akam a khetbuk in lei akhen ding a, amuk a hu in migilou-saloute athat ding.
english: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.

paite: Diktatna akawnggak ahi ding a, ginomna ataigakna ahi ding hi.
english: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.

paite: Huchi in ngia leh belamnou a-omkhawm ding ua, kelnou toh gialbem abokkhawm ding uh, bawngnou leh humpinelkai tuailai leh gan vak thaute a-omkhawm ding ua; naupangnou in api zungzung ding hi.
english: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.

paite: Bawng leh vompi agamtakhawm ding ua; anoute uh abokkhawm tiptep ding uhi; huan humpinelkai in bawngtal bang in buhpawl ane ding hi.
english: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.

paite: Nau nawitui ne lai thangtom ko gei ah a-om hiathiat ding a, nau nawitui nek tawpsa in guldekpak ko gei ah akhut anga ding.
english: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.

paite: Ka tang siangthou ah kihihnat a-omta kei ding a, kihihsiat leng a-om nawn kei ding, tuipite tui a adim gige bang in, TOUPA theihna in leitung adim ding hi.
english: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.

paite: Huan huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Jesse zung michih chiamtehna ding in a-om ding a, amah mahmah namte'n adong ding ua, akhawlna mun athupi ding hi.
heading: Taizakte Ahong Kik Nawn Ding Uh
english: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Toupa'n asi val khosuaksun amite, Assuria gam a kipan, Aigupta gam a kipan, Pathros gam a kipan, Kush gam a kipan, Elam gam a kipan, Shinar gam a kipan leh Hamath a kipan leh tuipi tuikulh gam a kipan, ala nawn ding a, anihveina ding in akhut azak nawn ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

paite: Huchi in namte a ding in chiamtehna atakkhe ding a, Israel delhkhiakte apikhawm ding a, Judah dalhte kawlmong li a kipan apikhawm ding.
english: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

paite: Huchi in Ephraimte hazatna abeita ding a, Judahte hihbuai mite hihmanthat in a-omta ding uh; Ephraimte'n Judahte ahaza nawnta kei ding ua, Judahte'n leng Ephraimte ahihbuai nawn kei ding uh.
english: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.

paite: Huchi in amaute tumlam ah Philistiate liangzang ah lengsuk in ava tuang ding ua; suahlam mite alokkhawm ding uh; Edom leh Moabte tung ah akhut uh akha ding ua, Ammon suante'n athu uh amangta ding uh.
english: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

paite: TOUPA'N Aigupta Tuipi lei ahihse vek ding a, Luipi leng ahuih sa huthut in akhut asinkhum ding a, luita sagihte a bawl hial in avo ding a, mite khepek leng kawt lou in apai galkah ding.
english: Yahweh will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam a kipan apaitouh ni ua Israelte a ding a lamlian ahong om bang in, akhosuaksun amite a ding in Assuria gam a kipan in lamlian ahong om ding hi.
english: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
